breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction entirely, as Strang splitting is the intended, more complex method. The agent failed to resolve this conflict correctly. Instead of removing the incorrect instruction, it merged them, stating to 'Advance the solution with explicit forward Euler time integration using Strang splitting', which is methodologically nonsensical and does not match the ground truth's correction.
